title: Rosewood Bungalow
description:
Home away from home! This Bungalow is nestled in one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Nashville! It's close and easily accessible to the downtown area and is close to many delicious restaurants, shopping and music venues. Also, we are located right in the middle of three great Universities; Vanderbilt, Belmont and Lipscomb. Come stay at the Bungalow and experience ALL that Music City has to offer!

The space
This cozy Bungalow has a two bedrooms, one full bath, kitchen, living room and dining area. It's three miles from downtown Nashville, close enough to walk to the 12th South area,  yet tucked away on a dead end street in a desirable, beautiful neighborhood! Enjoy sitting outside, on your private patio, with a cup of coffee, a glass of wine or simply enjoy the flowers, grill out or warm up by the chiminea!

Other things to note
WiFi information is written and hanging on the wall in the green bedroom.
